title: Wolf and Garden Anew
author: August Fairweather
blurb: Wren Kavanagh, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
